text:
mira: Hey team — opening a request for Azure capacity in FranceCentral. Need NDv4 (ND40rs_v2) and NCv3 slots for a short-term ramp + perf validation before a canary. Putting details here so ops + infra can track.

mira: Target SKUs & qty:
- Standard_ND40rs_v2 x8 (GPUs: 8 nodes, 1 GPU/node)
- Standard_NC24r_v3 x4 (GPUs: 4 nodes)
Region: francecentral
Subscription: sub-0a1b2c3d
Tenant: redwood-prod-eu
Window: 2024-03-20 -> 2024-05-20 (initially)
Expected concurrency: ~80 parallel sessions, peak token throughput ~1.2M tokens/day.

mira: Current quick check with az (output below):
```bash
az vm list-usage --location francecentral --output table
Name                                Limit  CurrentValue
Standard_ND40rs_v2                   0      0
Standard_NC24r_v3                    2      2
Total Regional Cores                  100    92
```

mira: I've opened an Azure support ticket: https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_Azure_Support/HelpAndSupportBlade/ticket/12345678 and internal SN: SN-7890. This is blocking our perf sweep planned for next week.

ashwin: Thanks — can you add short business justification (prod canary + load test) and approximate cost impact? Also who owns the billing?

mira: Justification: we need predictable dedicated capacity for low-p95 latency, reduce fallback to cheaper models during canary. If we don't get capacity we will delay canary by ~2 weeks. Estimated incremental cost: ~$1.8k/day for full run; cost owner: Platform Eng (billing tag: infra-capacity).

ashwin: Ok. Also do we want to request a temporary capacity reservation (reserved instance) vs quota bump? Reservations get priority and usually cheaper for the window.

mira: Good point. I want reservation for ND40rs_v2 x6 and NC24r_v3 x2 initially, with quota bump for the rest as fallback. I'll note that on the ticket.

tomasz: Heads up — last month we hit NSG/eph port limits in francecentral when spinning similar fleet. Please include vNet IP count and ephemeral port quotas in the request. Also double-check available subnet IPs.

ops-oncall: Confirming — we saw TCP ephemeral port exhaustion in francecentral during the last stress run. Recommend asking Microsoft to raise outbound ephemeral ports and network interface quotas, and pre-check NSG flow table limits.

mira: Adding that to the ticket now. Requesting: 
- Increase outbound ephemeral ports to 65535 scope for the subscription
- Increase NIC quota by +20
- Confirm NSG flow table headroom (we need ~200k flows)

azure-bot: Quota request submitted to Microsoft portal: Request ID req-2024-4578. Microsoft estimated response window: 48-72 hours. Link: https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_Azure_Support/HelpAndSupportBlade/ticket/req-2024-4578

sarah: Please CC infra-azure@redwood.ai and add ashwin + tomasz as owners on the support ticket so we get email updates.

mira: Done — ticket updated and owners added. I'll follow up with a status update in this thread once Microsoft responds.

mira: Action items:
- [mira] follow up with MS in 48h and paste response
- [ashwin] confirm budget ok for reservation by EOD
- [tomasz] validate subnet IPs and NSG flow headroom
- [ops-oncall] prep rollback plan if reservation doesn't land (use EU-west fallback)

mira: thanks all :thumbsup:
